title: Creatine RAW vs L-Citrulline RAW
directVerdict: Creatine RAW is the better fit for strength and power, while L-Citrulline RAW is the better fit for pump.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only Creatine RAW discloses: Creatine Monohydrate: 5 g per full serving.
Only L-Citrulline RAW discloses: L-Citrulline: 5 g per full serving.
Creatine RAW caffeine: Creatine RAW is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine. L-Citrulline RAW caffeine: L-Citrulline RAW is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: Creatine RAW: Creatine RAW: A single-ingredient micronized Creatine Monohydrate powder. The easiest concrete points are 5 g Creatine Monohydrate, 60 servings, Single ingredient. L-Citrulline RAW: L-Citrulline RAW: A single-ingredient, unflavored L-Citrulline powder. The easiest concrete points are 5 g L-Citrulline, 60 servings, Single ingredient.
tradeoffs: Creatine RAW: Customers who want a complete flavored pre-workout
L-Citrulline RAW: Customers who want a complete flavored pre-workout
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: Creatine RAW for strength and power; L-Citrulline RAW for pump.
